title: Fact
description: One observation about one object. Facts arrive independently, from different agents in different batches, so a fact validates alone: it names its own schema rather than inheriting one from a surrounding document. The value and provenance are checked against the SciType registry, not here — this file fixes only the envelope.

schema.description: Lineage id of the subject's schema.

schema_version.description: An append-only log accumulates versions forever; readers must handle every version ever written.

value.description: Any JSON value, or the absence markers. Validated against the field's declared type in the registry.
value.$comment: {"status":"n/a"} records not-applicable, which must not count against coverage as though it were unknown.

convention.description: Optional. The conventions the producer used, asserted so a mismatch with the field's declaration can be caught. A value computed under a different convention is a different value, not a conflicting one.
